name: av_gdp
description:
US real GDP series from Alpha Vantage (REAL_GDP), in billions of chained dollars.
Returns: {name, interval, unit, data: [{date, value}]} with values as strings, newest first. Alpha Vantage's JSON comes back unchanged, including its "Error Message" or "Information" notes; a network failure gives {"error": ...}.
Inputs (* required): interval (annual or quarterly; default annual).
Other GDP sources: fred_gdp, fred_gdp_growth, openbb_economy_gdp (other countries).
Key: ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY (alpha_vantage.api.key); when unset the 'demo' key is sent, which only serves Alpha Vantage's documentation examples. Free tier: 25 requests/day.
Example: {"interval": "quarterly"}
